This original hand-constructed synthetic bundle binds to actual deterministic QQQ
decisions from tests/fixtures/market_snapshot/manifest.json and
experiments/configs/baseline.yaml. It supplies no historical-news evidence, real
model inference, market-news observations or AI benefit claim. The example.invalid
URLs are local citation identifiers only. All new content is original synthetic
work under the repository MIT license; the existing synthetic market snapshot
retains its own CC0 provenance.

All timestamps are assigned synthetic scenario times. The declared 2025-11-30
freeze is a scenario value, not an actual creation or collection date. The bundle
was constructed on 2026-11-16. For each scenario: publication 19:00 UTC, observed
availability 19:05 UTC, analysis 19:10 UTC, output availability 19:11 UTC and
session-close-plus-one-minute decision 20:01 UTC. Next-session eligibility stays
unchanged.

QQQ at zero-based market-session index 200, 2025-10-09T20:01:00Z, binds to
8010b973262d56376bac824c10c3b91fb65c9ac6e2cb7af611d491a6ed4e6b07.
A fictional high-confidence negative blocking event blocks its one-share buy.
QQQ at index 202, 2025-10-13T20:01:00Z, binds to
7a7a97705eac7520429fd314d1c0e86fc09bb3f23cd7d9250780025dc6c9aff8.
A fictional negative high-risk event reduces its two-share buy to one share.
AI_NEUTRAL preserves both quantities and every original deterministic record.

model.json contains complete effective baseline settings, original config file
hash, dataset manifest hash, selection convention and AI policy. Its bytes are
manifest-verified alongside article/output and prompt/schema descriptor bytes.
This is a synthetic provenance descriptor, not model weights. The prompt/schema
descriptors were copied byte-for-byte from the original illustrative fixture.
No provider service was called. The engineered outcomes establish no predictive
or investment result.
